name: fourth_round_municipal
vintage: DCA Fourth Round calculation, October 2024 (obligations for 2025-2035)
source: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs, Affordable Housing Obligations for 2025-2035 (Fourth Round) Methodology and Background, October 2024, Appendix A
attribution: Source: New Jersey Department of Community Affairs, Affordable Housing Obligations for 2025-2035 (Fourth Round) Methodology and Background, October 2024, Appendix A.
notes: prospective_need_capped is the obligation after the 1,000-unit / 20% cap.

Qualified Urban Aid municipalities have no prospective need obligation under the Affordable Housing Law (report p. 18); their prospective-need zeros are not missing data. They may still have a present need.
Obligations are calculated need, not units built. Never describe a town as having met or failed its obligation.
status: DCA calculation (advisory under P.L.2024, c.2); municipalities may have adopted different numbers. Not a record of units built.
